citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:12 AM on
6/10/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the door and calling the Licensee who stated
no one was available for an inspection. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
